# Independent re-derivation: kic-005609180 (KBONUS-BKG PSF light curve)

Date 2026-10-17. Role: shared-code-free re-derivation. No file under `pipeline/` was read or imported; no wotan, no TLS. Code: numpy, scipy, astropy `BoxLeastSquares`, matplotlib only. All numbers below trace to `runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-005609180/rederive/{rederive_results.json, rederive_followup.json, rederive_box34.json, rederive_summary.json}`. The pipeline's `vet.json` was opened only after my numbers were written. This session resumed after a usage-limit interruption: the FITS headers and `vet.json` were re-read and the figures re-inspected; no numbers changed, only the header description string in `rederive_summary.json` was made exact (CROWDSAP is 0.949-1.0 per quarter, not a flat 1.0).

## 1. Data and detrending
- `LIGHTCURVE_STITCHED`, `SAP_QUALITY == 0`, finite, positive: 60,043 cadences, baseline 1459.5 d, Q1-Q17.
- Per-quarter normalisation by the median. Trend: time-windowed running median, 1.0 d window, computed per contiguous segment (segments broken at gaps > 0.5 d). Positive outliers clipped at 4 MAD (172 points); dips never clipped. Point-to-point MAD 1111 ppm.
- Second pass: in-transit cadences (|phase x P| < 0.75 x duration) masked from the median before re-detrending.

## 2. Blind BLS, 1-50 d, own grid
85,949 trial periods (frequency step set by 0.5 x the Sun-like central-transit duration at each period, oversampling 3), durations 1-12 h, likelihood objective. SDE = (peak - median) / std of the periodogram.

| rank | period [d] | SDE | depth [ppm] | duration [h] |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 21.1056 | 9.68 | 445 | 3.0 |
| 2 | 49.245 | 7.75 | 540 | 4.0 |
| 3 | 40.530 | 7.42 | 405 | 6.0 |

The pipeline period 21.1063 d is the top peak (ratio 0.99997, alias 1/1): `recovered_blind = true`. Inverted-flux null (2 - f), same grid: top SDE 7.74 at 1.044 d.

Caveats that matter: (a) with 0.5 d trimmed from every segment edge before detrending, the top peak moves to 45.98 d at SDE 9.64, and the 21.1 d peak falls to a local SDE of 4.9 with 30 distinct peaks above it; (b) a blind BLS of `SAP_FLUX` gives top peaks at 1.002 d (SDE 8.8), 2.576 d (7.3), 10.99 d (6.9) and nothing at 21.1 d (local maximum 19.78 d, SDE 5.2). An SDE of 9.7 is therefore at the ceiling that noise plus ramps reach on this star in a 1-50 d search.

## 3. Measurements at the best ephemeris
Refined on the masked re-detrended PSF flux by box-SNR maximisation: P = 21.106488 d. T0 depends on the box: 147.0785 BKJD (BJD 2454980.0785) for the 3.4 h box used for pipeline comparison; 147.1535 BKJD for the SNR-maximising 8 h box.

Errors are empirical: the standard deviation of box depths at 400 random phases (avoiding phase 0 and 0.5).

| quantity (3.4 h box, PSF) | all data | 12 gap-edge epochs removed |
|---|---|---|
| depth [ppm] | 483 +- 70 (SNR 6.9) | 233 +- 74 (SNR 3.1) |
| odd / even [ppm] | 489 +- 106 / 476 +- 99, 0.09 sigma | 279 / 185 |
| secondary at phase 0.5 [ppm] | -12 (-0.17 sigma) | - |
| deepest off-primary box | 124 ppm at phase 0.445, 2.4 sigma | - |
| per-year [ppm] | 522 +- 152, 315 +- 141, 777 +- 118, 394 +- 127 | -28 +- 149, 317 +- 131, 125 +- 115, 453 +- 131 |

Other boxes: 3.0 h (pipeline's `dur_h`) 509 +- 67 all data, 296 +- 77 without gap-edge epochs; 8 h (box-SNR maximum) 403 +- 54 all data, 39 +- 47 without gap-edge epochs, 15 +- 48 after 0.5 d edge trimming.

Transits: 69 epochs fall in the baseline, 63 have any data, 58 have >= 50 percent box coverage. Duration: the BLS top peak has 3.0 h, but box SNR keeps rising to the 8-10 h grid edge and the folded dip is asymmetric (deep ingress side, long shallow tail), so a transit duration is not well defined. Dropping the single strongest epoch (39, 7.4 ppt at the 8 h box) lowers the 8 h depth from 325 to 216 +- 48 ppm.

Twelve epochs (4, 12, 14, 23, 36, 39, 45, 48, 49, 52, 58, 63) fall within 0.5 d of a data-gap edge. Three of them dominate: epoch 4 (231.58 BKJD), 36 (906.99) and 39 (970.31) are 2.4-4.9 ppt deep in PSF flux and are, in the raw per-quarter-normalised flux, the first cadences of an exponential ~2 d recovery ramp after a gap (`events_raw_psf_vs_sap.png`). In SAP flux the same cadences are high or flat (-1092 +- 465, +1097 +- 501, -115 +- 350 ppm).

## 4. SAP vs PSF (dilution check)
Per-quarter headers: CROWDSAP 0.949-1.0, FLFRCSAP 0.79-0.99, NPIXSAP 2-4; median SAP/PSF flux 0.76 (consistent with FLFRCSAP). An on-target transit must therefore appear in SAP at >= 95 percent of its PSF depth. Measured at the same ephemeris, box and detrend: SAP 119 +- 72 ppm vs PSF 483 +- 70 (ratio 0.25 +- 0.15); without gap-edge epochs SAP 172 +- 76 vs PSF 233 +- 74; at 8 h SAP 13 +- 36 vs PSF 403 +- 54. Per-event PSF vs SAP depths scatter around 1:1 for ordinary epochs but the three large PSF events have null or opposite SAP sign. This is not dilution (dilution would scale SAP down uniformly); it is PSF-model behaviour after gaps.

## 5. Comparison with the pipeline (`vet.json`, read afterwards)
Pipeline: P 21.106289 d, T0 147.08145 BKJD, dur 3.0 h, depth_pass2 655.8 +- 114 ppm, snr_emp 12.3, odd/even 0.25 sigma, secondary -0.55 sigma, 61 events, gap_frac_1d 0.213, event_weighted_depth 318.5 ppm, event_chi2_const 87/60 dof, TLS SDE 8.8, stage2_pass true under v1.5 rules (failed v1.4 on tls_sde), no known-object matches, pixel directory absent.

Agree: period (9e-6 fractional), T0 (0.003 d), odd/even (none), secondary (none), number of events (58-63 vs 61).

Disagree: depth (483 +- 70 vs 656 +- 114, and 233 +- 74 once gap-edge epochs are removed), empirical SNR (6.9 vs 12.3; 3.1 without gap-edge epochs), robustness of blind recovery (top peak only on untrimmed data, at the noise ceiling), and origin (SAP shows a quarter of the PSF depth with CROWDSAP >= 0.95). The pipeline's own event_weighted_depth of 318 ppm and chi2 of 87 for 60 dof were already warning that the events are inconsistent with one depth.

## Verdict (candidate language only)
The 21.106 d first-screen signal in the KBONUS PSF flux of KIC 5609180 is reproduced as the top BLS peak only when post-gap cadences are kept. It is built from three post-gap PSF recovery ramps (epochs 4, 36, 39) plus a ~3 sigma residual that is at the level a 1-50 d search of this star's noise produces and that is absent from a blind BLS of the SAP flux. This re-derivation does not support it as an on-target transit signal; it should not advance to pixel-level work or candidate status on the present evidence. This is not a claim that nothing is there, only that the current evidence does not support an astrophysical origin.
